title: Running Commentary on Torah 44 — Mach'as Kaf el Kaf
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 44 — מחאת כף אל כף
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Three-layer line-by-line gloss: beginner = readable English prose with bracketed translations; intermediate = compact bilingual summary with citations; scholarly = terse Hebrew citation list. 5-segment coarse structure: seg 1 is the opening drasha (striking-palm-at-tefilah → 28 osiyos d-ovda d-bereshis → 28 parkin d-yadayim → EY-air); segs 2-5 are three successive peirushim of *'tefilos k-neged temidin tiknum'* (Berachos 26b) as (β) EY-amidah chain, (γ) mach'as-kaf nullifies machshavos-akum, (δ) tefilah reveals sodos-ha-Torah = kivshonos-shel-olam, (ε) tzedakah-l-EY saves from mabul-machshavos-zaros. Closing R"N note: 'I heard these all as *one* drasha; in his ksivah he split slightly — I do not know the reason'.
